body:
I notice the elderly cat yawn, its fur matted with dirt but warm against my hand. The stray dogs sniff each other, their noses twitching in excitement. Their eyes dart around nervously as they observe me. I can feel the soft earth beneath my feet crumble away under our weight, revealing old metal beams and rusted pipes.

"Come on," I say softly, patting one of the stray cats gently. "Let’s find somewhere safer."

We trudge through the ruins, the air thick with anticipation. Every step seems to lead us closer to safety. As we round another corner, I spot an open shed at the edge of the clearing where food was left for the animals earlier.
